name: ambika-2.0
description: Local development orchestrator for Ambika 2.0 (AGL ERP). Runs the existing backend and frontend dev servers together. Development convenience only - production is unchanged and still runs from deploy/ecosystem.config.cjs (pm2) and deploy/nginx.conf.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "blue.bold,magenta.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
